what: observe (Andrew, 2026-11-01 03:31, item 5: re-execution counters per query kind, so repeated work like 78k item-tree parses for 16k files shows directly). Please count per ingredient, in blaze-query: executed (in function.rs `run`, beside the WillExecute event), verified (in `mark`, beside DidValidateMemoizedValue) and reran (an execution of a key its ingredient already executed in the current revision; e.g. a bit per row set at run, cleared at a new revision). Keep the counts per thread (a small [u64; 3] array per ingredient in the thread-local, no shared atomic on these paths, none on the warm hit), and add `Storage::take_counts(&self, each: impl FnMut(&str, u64, u64, u64))` that sums and resets them, naming each kind as its span names it (`file_item_tree_query`, the spans `query_kind`). blaze-profile side is in: `blaze_profile::query_counts(QueryCounts { build, kind, executed, verified, reran })`, counters `query executed/verified/reran` with a `query_kind` column, and the view `reexecution_per_query_kind`. The daemon call is queued to cargo separately.
